piezas.titulo: Word reading: Environment and sustainable habits
texto: Reading and spelling of ecological and sustainability terms: «สิ่งแวดล้อม» has «สิ่ง» (low tone), «แวด» (low tone) and «ล้อม» (low-class consonant ล with ้, high tone). «ขยะ» is a word whose high-class consonant ข leads ย (อักษรนำ), producing a low tone on «ยะ» [khà-yà]. «ลด» has the low-class consonant ล with the final stop consonant ด (high tone in a short dead syllable). «ทรัพยากร» has ทร sounding as a sibilant [s] (ทร is pronounced ซ), «พย» (phá-yaa) and «กร» (mid tone). Recognising these spellings lets you read recycling guides and ecological regulations.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การลดการใช้พลาสติกแบบใช้ครั้งเดียวทิ้งช่วยบรรเทาปัญหาสิ่งแวดล้อมและมลพิษ» express?

opciones.texto: Reducing single-use plastics eases pollution and the environmental impact.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การลดการใช้พลาสติกแบบใช้ครั้งเดียวทิ้งช่วยบรรเทาปัญหาสิ่งแวดล้อมและมลพิษ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Saving electricity and tap water at home lowers bills and looks after natural resources.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Planting trees in the city increases green areas and mitigates accumulated heat.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ทรัพยากร» (resources), how is the initial consonant cluster ทร pronounced?

opciones.texto: As a voiceless sibilant [s] (ทร is pronounced as ซ)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: in standard Thai, the irregular cluster ทร is pronounced as [s] (ซ).
Incorrect: it is not pronounced t-r in regular Sanskrit loanwords.
Incorrect: ทร is a consonant, not a vowel sound.
